info.title: arcadia agent IPC
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over NDJSON on \\.\pipe\arcadia-agent-<SID>, served by `arcadia.exe --agent`. Supersedes docs/specs/phase-2-skeleton/contracts/ipc.openrpc.json (v0.2.0); the only change is the agent.shutdown notification [EXE-013..EXE-015]. One message per line; max 1048576 bytes per message excluding the trailing \n [IPC-012]; larger messages close only that connection, response not guaranteed [IPC-003]. Batches (JSON arrays) are rejected with a single -32600, id null [IPC-010]. Requests without id are notifications and get no response [IPC-011]. jsonrpc must be exactly "2.0" and params, if present, must be null, an array or an object, otherwise -32600 [IPC-009]. Methods without params accept params absent, null, [] or {} [IPC-008]; any non-empty array/object is -32602 [IPC-002].

methods.name: agent.heartbeat
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification every 5 s (no id, no response) [IPC-004]

methods.name: agent.shutdown
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification sent once to every connection when the agent starts an orderly shutdown, and as the first message of any connection accepted while draining (no id, no response). The server then waits up to shutdownDrainMs for the clients to close their connections before closing them itself. A client that receives it must not restart the agent; the desktop UI closes itself [EXE-013, EXE-014, EXE-015, EXE-016, EXE-017]

params.name: reason
params.description: quit: tray "Sair"; session-end: WM_ENDSESSION; signal: Ctrl+C/SIGTERM; other: the tray loop ended on its own, or Serve ended with an error (in that case every connection is already closed, so no client receives it) [EXE-016, EXE-026]

dataDir.description: Absolute Root resolved by the agent [DSK-006]
